issues.description: The tensor-networks zero-state function name is inconsistent between the problem statement/solution and the template. The problem statement and the solution implement/use create_zero_state(num_qubits), but the template defines init_zero_state(num_qubits). This naming mismatch will prevent students from finding/implementing the expected function and will break tests or example usage that call create_zero_state.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function init_zero_state to create_zero_state to match the problem statement and solution (or add a small wrapper def create_zero_state(...) that calls init_zero_state(...)). Update any docstrings/comments to reference the same identifier so tests and student instructions align.
